segments.text: a GitHub project a day. Today's project is Data Surf. Data Surf is your AI powered notebook that brings your files,
notes, and the web directly into your stream of thought. It's built to help you research and think simultaneously.
No more juggling tabs, scrolling endlessly, or copy pasting between apps.
Surf lets you ask questions about YouTube videos, PDFs, or web pages, and it responds contextually, integrating sources, citations, and even timestamps
right in your notes. You can store everything locally in open formats, organize it into notebooks, and work offline.
